description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android widget extending TextView that implements LogNode interface to output formatted log messages to a user interface component. It includes methods for formatting log data, handling log levels, managing chained log nodes, and updating the UI thread safely.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages, formatting them according to log priority and message details, and supporting chainable log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, including priority, tag, message, and exception details, appending it to the LogView and forwarding to the next LogNode if exists.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a non-null string with a delimiter to a StringBuilder.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView content.
